title: andropogon nutans var. stipoides
intro: Andropogon nutans var. stipoides, commonly known as Black Needle Grass, is a perennial grass species native to Australia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues and offers several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and wound-healing properties. The therapeutic actions of Black Needle Grass include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and acting as an antiseptic agent. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
